purpose: Teach: 序文/ステートメント/コーティング/受領/取締り/移管/とりまとめ/仲間入り

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新しい規則手帳の序文を読まれましたか
lines.en: Have you had a chance to read the preface to the new regulations handbook?
lines.style: Professional but approachable. Opens with measured clarity. Steady cadence, no rush. The tone of someone giving a briefing who respects the listener.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、公式ステートメントを発信されたんですね
lines.en: Yes—so the department issued an official statement about it.
lines.style: Attentive, confirming understanding back. Slight pause at the dash. Calm tone, not defensive. The rhythm of someone tracking information carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、武器のコーティング技術を研究します
lines.en: We're conducting research on weapon-coating technology as part of our modernization efforts.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, informational. Steady pace, professional register. No embellishment—just laying out the facts. Voice sits level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、被害届の受領を確認いただきました
lines.en: Got it. So you've confirmed receipt of the incident report we filed.
lines.style: Registering the detail, nodding along. Slightly formal to match the bureaucratic tone. Small beat on the dash. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、年末年始の犯罪取締りを強化します
lines.en: We're stepping up enforcement operations for the year-end and New Year period.
lines.style: Direct statement of action. Even tone, no hesitation. Professional weight without sounding heavy. The cadence of someone announcing a decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、捜査資料の移管手続が必要ですね
lines.en: Understood. So we'll need to follow the proper procedure for transferring the investigation files.
lines.style: Absorbing and restating. Slightly formal, careful with details. Small breath before the second clause. Tone of someone checking off steps.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民意見のとりまとめを地域会議でなさいますね
lines.en: The community will have a voice in this too—we'll be gathering citizen input through local council meetings.
lines.style: Inclusive, reassuring undertone. Steady pace but warmer than before. The opening has slight emphasis on 'community.' Not lecturing, inviting participation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、国際警察組織への仲間入りを果たされましたね
lines.en: That's great to hear. Congratulations on becoming part of the international police organization.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. Slight uptick in vocal energy on the praise. Conversational but respectful. The tone shifts to something more personal, less procedural.
